english.title: Master of ship / commander of aircraft fail to make report to Commissioners on arrival in port / airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the

(A)_[master of a ship]_
(B)_[commander of an aircraft]_

arriving or expected to arrive in a

(C)_[port]_
(D)_[airport]_

situated at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) failed to make a report to the Commissioners as required by or under section 35 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(5) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 35(5)(b) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 provides that any goods required to be reported which are not duly reported may be detained by any officer until so reported or until the omission is explained to the satisfaction of the Commissioners, and may in the meantime be deposited in a Queen's warehouse.
